name: football-content-ops
title_zh: 一个账号的足球内容从选题到发布全流程手册
tagline_zh: 小红书、抖音、FlowUs 三端统一打法：每队一套专属配色、固定 IP 吉祥物、图卡模板直接套。
tagline_en: One workflow for Xiaohongshu, Douyin & FlowUs: per-team colors, fixed mascot, ready card templates. Stop juggling.
desc_en: End-to-end content-operation methodology for a Chinese football-content account (@bawbaw 足球观察员), unified across Xiaohongshu · Douyin · FlowUs. From topic to verified content, card design, per-team color theming, a fixed IP mascot, and publish/record. Use when 发一篇, 做图卡, 按队换色, 做封面, 发小红书, 发抖音, 记 FlowUs, or 复盘.
why_zh: 把内容运营沉淀成可复用的方法论，而非零散灵感。从选题到复盘，每一步都有明确产出物和检查点，换队。
why_en: It's a codified methodology, not scattered tips. Every step has a concrete deliverable and a checkpoint, so switching teams or.
limit_zh: 只服务中文足球内容账号的既定流程。不含爆款算法、涨粉策略或选题灵感生成；不接入任何发布 API，发布动作仍需手动完成。
limit_en: Only for the established workflow of one Chinese football content account. No growth hacks, no topic ideation, no auto-publishing—posting stays.
title_en: End-to-end ops manual for a Chinese football content account
